parsed.notes:
Required Qualifications sets required labels; Preferred/Bonus Qualifications sets nice_to_have labels, including its unmapped skills.
Only candidate qualifications were labeled; technologies and practices appearing solely in responsibilities or company descriptions were excluded.
AI/ML models and ML optimization techniques explicitly name AI/ML and machine learning, respectively.
Hardware-specific design, simulation, deployment, and debugging were left unmapped rather than treated as software architecture, software testing, or AI model deployment.
Verilog and SystemVerilog are alternatives, as are MLIR and TVM examples for compiler technologies; all are unmapped, so there are no mapped alternative groups.
Research publications and open-source contributions were read literally as contribution credentials, not as named technical skills.
